segments.comment: After #reqmenu, the m key reaches do_reqmenu() with iflags.menu_requested still set and cancels with "Double m prefix, canceled." After m, #reqmenu draws doextcmd()'s "prefix has no effect" line and the inventory command is then refused under was_m_prefix. #reqmenu alone leaves was_m_prefix clear because func is still doextcmd() at cmd.c:3771, so # , i and , are refused as after a movement prefix.
